The [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] '''Zen Lotto''' was the chairman of the largest [[Grav-ball/Legends|Grav-ball]] federation. He judged some of the most massive matches personally on the energy fields of some of the most famous [[Nubian]] Grav-ball arenas.
